title: Find your way
lead: Not sure which app you need? Describe your task, explore how the apps connect, or check a file. Everything runs on this page, offline.
askLbl: What do you need to do?
askPh: e.g. check if a photo is authentic and remove its metadata
askHint: Local keyword rules only: your words never leave this page.
ex1: translate a text and listen to it
ex2: prepare for the amateur radio exam
ex3: find broken links on my website
noMatch: No direct match for these words. Here are three good starting points; you can also rephrase.
askEmpty: Write a few words about what you want to do.
csLead: Each star is an app, each line a declared relation, the colour is the section. Click a star or press Enter to open its card.
csGraph: Graph of apps. Arrow keys move between stars, Enter opens the card.
csHint: Hover, focus or choose an app to see its connections.
auTitle: Auditor: can I trust this file?
auLead: Choose or drop a file. It is read in this browser tab only; nothing is uploaded or stored. A quick triage looks for what Proveniență (content credentials), Curățitor (hidden metadata) and Surveyor (links) examine in depth.
fC2paYes: A Content Credentials (C2PA) manifest is embedded. It was not validated here: the signer and the trust list need Proveniență.
fC2paNo: No Content Credentials manifest found. Its absence does not show the file is fake or genuine.
fAi: The file declares AI generation or editing ({0}).
fSw: Software that wrote or edited the file: {0}.
fEnc: The document is encrypted or protected.
fLinks: {0} distinct links in readable text, on {1} domains: {2}.
fNoLinks: No links found in readable text.
fNet: Whether the links still work needs the network: use Surveyor.
fTrunc: Large file: only the first and last {0} MB were scanned.
fNoHash: Too large to hash in the browser.
sumOk: No warning signals in this quick check.
auNote: Quick local triage, not a verdict: it cannot validate signatures, trust lists or whether the content is true. Use the three apps for the full analysis.
auAppsNote: Open the app, then drop the same file there (the apps live on separate sites, so the file cannot be passed automatically).
ldLead: Pick files exported from the apps (.fff.json, CSV, text, Markdown, GPX, ICS). They are indexed in memory only and disappear when you close or clear.
ldConsent: I choose these files myself; they may be read in memory, never stored or sent.
ldNeed: Tick the box and choose files first.
ldLimit: Limit: each app keeps its data in its own browser storage on a different site, which this page cannot read. Export from the app and pick the file here.
